d1-checkin.title: Airport check-in and luggage drop
d1-checkin.note: Check passports, baggage allowance, airline desk and gate before boarding.

d1-pp-lounge.title: Priority Pass lounges at SFO (optional)
d1-pp-lounge.note: The Club SFO is in Terminal 1 near Gate B4, while LH459 departs International Terminal G. Allow plenty of walking time. Check guest privileges for all four.

d1-flight.title: Lufthansa LH459 nonstop to Munich
d1-flight.note: Departs SFO at 9:40 PM; scheduled arrival in Munich is 5:55 PM the following day.

d1-overnight.title: Overnight flight
d1-overnight.note: Sleep and get ready for the cold Munich evening.

d2-arrive.title: Arrive at Munich Airport (MUC)
d2-arrive.note: Scheduled arrival is 5:55 PM local time.

d2-ticket.title: Find airport S-Bahn and buy tickets
d2-ticket.note: Follow S-Bahn signs; check valid group airport-city tickets and fares before purchase.

d2-s8.note: Take S8 from Munich Airport toward the city, about 33 minutes to Rosenheimer Platz (subject to service). Follow signs for Gasteig / Muffatwerk and Holiday Inn to reach the indoor Motorama passage.

d2-hotel.title: Check in at Holiday Inn Munich
d2-hotel.note: At Rosenheimer Platz, follow signs for Gasteig / Muffatwerk rather than the Rosenheimer Platz street exit. Turn left in the station hall, pass the glass doors to Motorama and turn right. Stay on the same level past ALDI and HIT, then follow Holiday Inn signs up to reception. If the passage is closed, use the street entrance at Hochstraße 3.

d2-dinner.title: Dinner and rest
d2-dinner.note: Eat somewhere nearby and rest after the overnight flight.

d3-frauen.title: Frauenkirche Cathedral
d3-frauen.note: See Munich's famous twin towers and explore the cathedral if it is open.
d3-frauen.brief: See Munich's famous twin towers and explore the cathedral if it is open.

d3-stpeter.title: Meet near St. Peter's Church
d3-stpeter.note: Walk to the meeting point before 10:30 AM and look for the yellow umbrella.

d3-tour.title: Walkative! Old Town guided tour
d3-tour.note: An English-language walking tour is confirmed. Be at the meeting point early.
d3-tour.brief: An English-language guided walk through six Old Town highlights. Open the six-stop section below; the 10:45 tour includes the 11:00 Glockenspiel.

tourStops.title: St. Peter's Church
tourStops.note: One of Munich's oldest parish churches, called Alter Peter; a landmark of the medieval old town.

tourStops.title: Marienplatz
tourStops.note: The New and Old Town Halls and the 11:00 AM Glockenspiel with its jousting figures.

tourStops.title: Old City Palace (Alter Hof)
tourStops.note: The medieval palace of the Wittelsbach dukes of Bavaria.

tourStops.title: Hofbräuhaus
tourStops.note: A renowned historic beer hall at the heart of Bavarian beer culture.

tourStops.title: Max-Joseph-Platz
tourStops.note: The royal square by the Munich Residence and the National Theatre.

tourStops.title: Odeonsplatz
tourStops.note: Italian-inspired architecture and important events in Munich's political history.

d3-lunch.title: Lunch at Viktualienmarkt
d3-lunch.note: Try Bavarian foods at the traditional outdoor food market.
d3-lunch.brief: Try Bavarian foods at the traditional outdoor food market.

d3-kustermann.title: Kustermann: WÜSTHOF and RIEDEL shopping
d3-kustermann.note: Optional shopping for German kitchen knives, glassware and cookware.
d3-kustermann.brief: Optional shopping for German kitchen knives, glassware and cookware.

d3-residenz.title: Munich Residenz Palace
d3-residenz.note: Explore historic palace rooms. Admission has not been purchased yet.
d3-residenz.brief: Explore historic palace rooms. Admission has not been purchased yet.

d3-max.title: Walk along Maximilianstraße
d3-max.note: Enjoy historic buildings and shops before returning to Marienplatz.
d3-max.brief: Enjoy historic buildings and shops before returning to Marienplatz.

d3-music.title: Possible Christmas music at Marienplatz
d3-music.note: A musical performance around 5:30 PM is not yet confirmed; visit the market if there is no performance.
d3-music.brief: A musical performance around 5:30 PM is not yet confirmed; visit the market if there is no performance.

d3-market.title: Marienplatz Christmas market and dinner
d3-market.note: Browse Christmas stalls, food and warm drinks.
d3-market.brief: Browse Christmas stalls, food and warm drinks.

d4-breakfast.title: Breakfast and early transfer to castle tour meeting point
d4-breakfast.note: Allow time from Holiday Inn Munich City Centre to Sonnenstraße 1 (bus stop outside Fielmann). Mentor Reisen's winter update requests check-in around 8:40 AM; the coach leaves by 8:50 AM at the latest. Do not follow the old 9:15 AM departure.

d4-tour.title: Mentor Reisen: Two Castles tour (EARLIER departure)
d4-tour.note: Nov 18 update from Susanne, Team Mentor Reisen: winter castle guided tours start earlier. Please arrive at Sonnenstraße 1, 80331 Munich, at about 8:40 AM to check in. Everyone MUST depart by 8:50 AM at the latest—not 9:15 AM. The operator asks guests to acknowledge receipt. Confirm castle admission and payment separately.

d4-hohen.title: Hohenschwangau Castle
d4-hohen.note: Castle entrance tickets were held by the operator; confirm payment and admission time.
d4-hohen.brief: Ludwig II's yellow childhood castle; tour takes about 45 minutes. Capture Alpsee and Neuschwanstein views; watch icy paths.

d4-neusch.title: Neuschwanstein Castle
d4-neusch.note: Ask the operator for the confirmed entry time and take care on icy slopes.
d4-neusch.brief: Ludwig II's fairy-tale castle inspired Disney's imagery. See the Throne and Singers' halls; Mary's Bridge offers the classic photo angle.

d4-alpsee.title: Lake Alpsee scenery
d4-alpsee.note: Optional lakeside photo stop, depending on your tour and the weather.
d4-alpsee.brief: Alpine lake for mountain reflections in clear weather. Avoid lakeside paths during snow, strong wind or ice.

d4-bridge.title: Marienbrücke viewpoint
d4-bridge.note: Optional bridge view; it may close in winter due to ice or snow.
d4-bridge.brief: Iconic side-on Neuschwanstein photo spot over a deep gorge. Closed in icy weather? Skip it safely.

d4-return.title: Return to Munich and prepare for tomorrow
d4-return.note: The Nov 18 operator message does not confirm the revised return time. Pack luggage and EC353 tickets. The Nov 23 Blacklane van is canceled; use S-Bahn to München Hbf.

d5-checkout.title: Early checkout at Holiday Inn
d5-checkout.note: Check out around 4:50–5:05 AM with all luggage, breakfast and EC353 QR tickets; leave for Rosenheimer Platz around 5:05 AM.

d5-platform.title: Find EC353 platform at München Hbf
d5-platform.note: From the underground S-Bahn station, follow signs to the mainline train platforms. Confirm EC353 / RE25/353 departures and the actual platform. Aim to be there by 6:25 AM.

d5-train.title: EC353 train from Munich to Prague
d5-train.note: Four tickets bought: second class, coach 259, seats 54, 56, 65, 67. 6:44 AM to 12:21 PM.

d5-prague.title: Arrive at Prague Main Station
d5-prague.note: Scheduled arrival at Praha hlavní nádraží: 12:21 PM.

d5-grand.title: Bag drop and lunch at The Grand Mark
d5-grand.note: Drop bags, eat lunch and head to Powder Tower in time for a 2:50 PM check-in. If the room is not ready, check in after the tour.

d5-miru.title: Optional Náměstí Míru Christmas market
d5-miru.note: After the tour, head to Peace Square only if the family has energy; otherwise return directly to the hotel.
d5-miru.brief: Optional evening Christmas market, subject to energy and tour ending time.

d5-evening.title: Dinner, The Grand Mark check-in and rest
d5-evening.note: If you only dropped bags earlier, check in at the hotel after the tour or market.

d6-transit.title: The Grand Mark to Pražský hrad tram stop
d6-transit.note: Take Metro B to Můstek, change to A, then tram 22 from Malostranská. Arrive by 8:45 AM.

d6-castle.title: Prague Castle and St. Vitus Cathedral
d6-castle.note: Prioritize castle interiors and St. Vitus; other ticketed rooms depend on queues within the 9:00–11:35 shared schedule.
d6-castle.brief: See St. Vitus Cathedral, the Old Royal Palace and Golden Lane. Castle interiors close earlier in winter.

d6-starbucks.title: Starbucks with castle viewpoint
d6-starbucks.note: Photo and coffee stop before walking toward Strahov.
d6-starbucks.brief: Photo and coffee stop before walking toward Strahov.

d6-river.title: Sunset walk across Charles Bridge
d6-river.note: Walk across with friends from 4:00 to 4:40 PM for dusk views.
d6-river.brief: Photograph the castle and river from Charles Bridge around blue hour. Dress for the wind.

d6-petrin.title: Walk from Strahov up to Petřín Hill
d6-petrin.note: Follow the hill path for views; observation tower entry is optional. No uphill funicular.
d6-petrin.brief: Walk uphill from Strahov for views of Prague's rooftops. Hill paths may be icy.

d6-down.title: Petřín funicular downhill to Újezd
d6-down.note: Allow time for queues; check service on the day and use a safe alternative if closed.
d6-down.brief: Allow time for queues; check service on the day and use a safe alternative if closed.

d6-rest.title: Return to The Grand Mark for a break
d6-rest.note: The shared daytime route ends; the evening concert is an optional separate plan.

d6-dinner.title: Dinner near Municipal House
d6-dinner.note: Leave a buffer before the optional 8 PM concert if attending.

d6-entry.title: Go to Smetana Hall
d6-entry.note: The concert is not booked. Buy tickets and confirm entry rules first.

d6-concert.title: Classical music at Smetana Hall (not booked)
d6-concert.note: An 8 PM concert is under consideration; tickets have not been purchased.
d6-concert.brief: An 8 PM concert is under consideration; tickets have not been purchased.

d6-back.title: Return to The Grand Mark
d6-back.note: Pack ahead for early breakfast and checkout on Nov 25.

d7-breakfast.title: Early breakfast and packing
d7-breakfast.note: Have breakfast at 7 AM, check out and leave luggage before visiting Vyšehrad. Meet friends at lunch.

d7-checkout.title: Early checkout and luggage storage at The Grand Mark
d7-checkout.note: Check out early and leave luggage with reception. Return around 5:10 PM to collect it.

d7-lunch.title: Meet friends for lunch at Mincovna (suggested)
d7-lunch.note: Confirm the Old Town restaurant and meeting point with friends. No reservation yet; allow time for the 2 PM Klementinum tour.

d7-manuf.title: Manufaktura gifts at Na Příkopě 16
d7-manuf.note: Czech soaps, skincare and souvenirs without backtracking to Melantrichova.
d7-manuf.brief: Czech soaps, skincare and souvenirs without backtracking to Melantrichova.

d7-move.title: Collect luggage and check in at Hotel Royal
d7-move.note: After Palladium, collect luggage at The Grand Mark and take Metro B to Křižíkova. Leave luggage at Hotel Royal before visiting Peace Square.

d7-dinner.title: Dinner with friends and return to Hotel Royal
d7-dinner.note: Eat near Peace Square or in Karlín. Coordinate tomorrow's CK bus meetup and rest early.

d8-breakfast.title: Meet friends early at Hotel Royal for the 7 AM coach
d8-breakfast.note: Suggested meet-up at 5:50–6:00 AM, leaving promptly via Metro B / Anděl to Na Knížecí. Confirm the exact meeting time with friends and allow boarding time.

d8-busout.title: RegioJet outbound: Prague → CK (early exit at Špičák)
d8-busout.note: Issued ticket: 7:00 AM from Praha Na Knížecí, platform 1, seats 13–16, €31.40. Ticket arrival at AN is 9:40 AM; ask staff to let you off at Špičák around 9:35 AM. If unavailable, get off at AN.
d8-busout.brief: 7 AM, platform 1. Planned early exit at Špičák, around 9:35 AM.

d8-walk.title: Get off at Špičák
d8-walk.note: Confirm with staff, then walk from the northern bus stop through Budějovická Gate to Latrán and the castle. This avoids backtracking. The northern gateway to the historic town, within walking distance of Latrán and the castle. Photo tip: Continue toward the old gate; the photo shows the Špičák district, not the bus stop.
d8-walk.brief: Enter from the north; depart from AN on the east side.

d8-castle.title: Castle courtyards and Cloak Bridge
d8-castle.note: Walk through the historic courtyards to the multi-level stone arch bridge and panoramic views of red roofs and the Vltava bend. Skip seasonal palace tours and gardens; beware icy stairs. The historic courtyards preserve Renaissance architecture; the impressive multi-level Cloak Bridge connects parts of the upper castle. Photo tip: Capture the painted walls, stone arches and S-shaped Vltava bend.
d8-castle.brief: Classic red roofs and river panorama.

d8-latran.title: Lazebnický Bridge
d8-latran.note: Return downhill toward Latrán and cross the bridge into Old Town. Photograph the painted tower and riverside houses. A historic bridge connecting Latrán with the Inner Town, with picturesque views of riverside houses and the castle tower. Photo tip: Photograph the castle from the bridge.
d8-latran.brief: Classic tower and river photo spot.

d8-lunch.title: Lunch at Krčma Šatlava medieval tavern
d8-lunch.note: Try garlic soup in a bread bowl, grilled ribs and mixed grilled meat. No reservation; choose another nearby Czech restaurant if full. A medieval-style Czech tavern with rustic stone walls and open-fire cooking. Try garlic soup in a bread bowl, grilled pork ribs, a mixed grill or roast duck, subject to the menu. Photo tip: Photograph the rustic interior and grill; no reservation has been made.
d8-lunch.brief: Warm up over fire-grilled meat and garlic soup.

d8-oldtown.title: Široká Street and Old Town lanes
d8-oldtown.note: Browse colorful buildings, art shops and Czech souvenirs. Shorten outdoor time in snow. One of the wider streets in the medieval town, known for historic architecture, galleries and artisan shops. Photo tip: Photograph colorful façades and cobblestones.
d8-oldtown.brief: Colorful old houses and souvenir shops.

d8-river.title: Seminární Garden viewpoint
d8-river.note: Photograph the castle, river and red roofs from the viewpoint on Horní Street. Then continue east toward AN. Skip if weather or timing is poor. A free viewpoint on Horní Street overlooking the castle, painted tower and medieval rooftops without climbing a tower. Photo tip: Ideal for a family photo before walking east to AN.
d8-river.brief: Final family photo with the castle.

d8-market.title: Svornosti Square Christmas market
d8-market.note: Official market runs today 11 AM–6 PM. Browse craft stalls and try mulled wine, warm drinks or snacks. The historic heart of town, surrounded by Renaissance façades, the Town Hall and a Marian column. Svornost means harmony or unity. Photo tip: Photograph the square and market stalls; try Svařák mulled wine. The photo is a reference view, not today's market.

d8-busback.title: RegioJet return: Český Krumlov AN → Prague
d8-busback.note: Issued ticket: AN platform 7 at 4:00 PM, Praha Na Knížecí 6:45 PM. Seats 5–8; €35.10, round trip €66.50 for four.
d8-busback.brief: 4 PM from AN platform 7; 6:45 PM in Prague.

d8-hotel.title: Return to Hotel Royal and pack for home
d8-hotel.note: After the scheduled 6:45 PM arrival, take Metro B from Anděl to Křižíkova, have dinner and pack. Tomorrow's airport pickup follows the latest booking.

d9-checkout.title: Check out of Hotel Royal
d9-checkout.note: Leave the hotel ready for early pickup.

d9-black.title: Blacklane Business Van to Prague Airport
d9-black.note: Confirmed pickup at 6:30 AM. Airport arrival around 7:02 AM is an estimate.

d9-airport.title: Arrive at Prague Airport and check in
d9-airport.note: Check bags and security at Terminal 2 for the Schengen flight.

d9-pp-prg.title: Priority Pass: Erste Premier Lounge at PRG
d9-pp-prg.note: Optional lounge in Terminal 2 airside on Level 3, open from 5 AM. Check guest rules.

d9-transfer.title: Transfer at Zurich Airport
d9-transfer.note: Allow time for passport control and your US-bound departure gate.

d9-pp-zrh.title: Priority Pass: Aspire Lounge at Zurich (E Gates only)
d9-pp-zrh.note: Only if LX38 uses E gates. Aspire is above Gate E52; skip if assigned to D gates or if the connection is tight.

d9-lx38.title: SWISS LX38: Zurich to SFO
d9-lx38.note: Depart 1:15 PM; arrive SFO at 4:30 PM Pacific time.

d9-uber.title: Uber Comfort pickup from SFO
d9-uber.note: Pickup is booked for 4:30 PM, the same as scheduled landing. Verify or adjust to allow for baggage and immigration.

d6-lunch.title: Quick lunch near the castle; walk toward Strahov
d6-lunch.note: Keep lunch short to reach Strahov at 1 PM. Pork's is no longer on the fixed lunch route.

d6-strahov.title: Strahov Monastery and Library
d6-strahov.note: Library access depends on tickets; enjoy the exterior and viewpoints if time is short.
d6-strahov.brief: Ornate Baroque library and panoramic viewpoints. Confirm entry tickets and access restrictions.

d6-mala.title: Walk through Malá Strana (Lesser Town)
d6-mala.note: See Malostranské Square and St. Nicholas Church exterior; Kampa and Pork's remain optional.
d6-mala.brief: See Malostranské Square and St. Nicholas Church exterior; Kampa and Pork's remain optional.

d6-meet.title: Meet friends at Pražský hrad Tram 22 stop
d6-meet.note: Friends depart Hotel Royal via Křižíkova Metro B. Meet at 8:45 AM and walk about 5 minutes to the castle; confirm meeting point together.

d7-klementinum.title: Klementinum guided tour
d7-klementinum.note: Aim for a 2 PM English guided tour, subject to tickets; view the Baroque library and expect stairs.
d7-klementinum.brief: See the Baroque library and tower on a timed guided tour. Expect stair climbing.

d7-na-prikope.title: Shopping on Na Příkopě
d7-na-prikope.note: Browse shops with friends. Skip dedicated stops at the already-seen Powder Tower and Municipal House.
d7-na-prikope.brief: Browse shops with friends before Manufaktura and Palladium.

d7-palladium.title: Palladium shopping mall
d7-palladium.note: Shops, stationery and Czech souvenirs with friends.
d7-palladium.brief: Shops, stationery and Czech souvenirs with friends.

d3-mvv-group-ticket.note: Nov 21: Select Group Day Ticket (Gruppen-Tageskarte), validity Zone M, and travel date Nov 21 in the MVV App. One ticket covers 2 adults + children ages 14 and 10 travelling together; valid until 6:00 AM Nov 22. Not purchased yet. Do not select M–5 (airport zones).

d4-mvv-group-ticket.title: Buy MVV Group Day Ticket · Zone M
d4-mvv-group-ticket.brief: Buy one NEW Group Day Ticket for Zone M in the MVV App (€19.70 for all 4).
d4-mvv-group-ticket.note: Nov 22: Select Group Day Ticket (Gruppen-Tageskarte), Zone M, travel date Nov 22, one ticket for 2 adults and children ages 14 and 10. Valid until 6:00 AM Nov 23. Covers local transit to the tour meeting point at Sonnenstraße 1, NOT travel to the castles, which is on the booked Mentor Reisen coach. Be at the meeting point at 8:40 AM; departure no later than 8:50 AM. Not purchased yet.

d5-meet-tour.title: Walk to Powder Tower meeting point
d5-meet-tour.note: Arrive by 2:50 PM. Meet the 100 Spires Prague guide with a red umbrella marked with a large white 100.

d5-walkative-tour.title: Confirmed Walkative! Prague Old Town & Jewish Quarter tour
d5-walkative-tour.note: English tour, 2 adults + 2 children, 3:00–5:45 PM. Pay what you wish. Meet at Powder Tower under the red 100 Spires umbrella. Published end point is Lennon Wall.
d5-walkative-tour.brief: Explore Old Town Square, the Astronomical Clock, Josefov and Charles Bridge. Six highlighted stops are listed below.

tourStops.title: Powder Tower
tourStops.note: Gothic gate and starting point of the royal coronation route; tour meeting point.

tourStops.title: Old Town Square
tourStops.note: The historic main square, including Gothic and other period architecture.

tourStops.title: Astronomical Clock
tourStops.note: The medieval timepiece on Old Town Hall.

tourStops.title: Josefov Jewish Quarter
tourStops.note: Jewish history and landmark synagogues; indoor admission is not included.

tourStops.title: Charles Bridge
tourStops.note: Historic stone bridge across the Vltava with views of the castle.

tourStops.title: Lennon Wall
tourStops.note: Published end point in Malá Strana, a landmark of free expression.

d8-to-station.title: Walk to CK AN bus terminal, platform 7
d8-to-station.note: Leave by 3:20 PM and reach AN by 3:40 PM. Allow extra time for snow; do not return to Špičák. The main bus terminal east of the historic center. Arrive by 3:40 PM for the 4 PM departure from platform 7. Photo tip: Follow current signage; the historical photo may differ from the current terminal.

d5-sbahn.title: Walk to Rosenheimer Platz; S8 to Munich Central Station
d5-sbahn.note: Blacklane van canceled. Target the published 5:17 AM westbound S8 at Rosenheimer Platz, due at München Hbf at 5:23 AM; this is the regular timetable, not a confirmed live trip. Check construction and departures. The Motorama passage may be closed this early, so use street entrances if needed. A valid Nov 22 Zone M group day ticket generally lasts until 6:00 AM Nov 23; otherwise buy tickets before boarding.

d7-vysehrad-transit.title: Travel to Vyšehrad
d7-vysehrad-transit.note: Walk to Hlavní nádraží, take Metro C toward Háje to Vyšehrad and walk to the fortress.

d7-vysehrad.title: Vyšehrad fortress
d7-vysehrad.note: Visit the ramparts, river viewpoints, St Martin's Rotunda and the cemetery. Basilica interior is optional, subject to opening hours and time.
d7-vysehrad.brief: Historic fortress, river views and cemetery; optional basilica interior.

d7-naplavka.title: Náplavka riverside walk
d7-naplavka.note: Descend toward Výtoň and follow the east bank north. Use a tram or safer roads if icy or too cold.
d7-naplavka.brief: Walk north along the Vltava; take a tram if needed.

d7-dancing.title: Dancing House
d7-dancing.note: Photograph the exterior from a safe location. Optional rooftop Glass Bar coffee, subject to opening and time.
d7-dancing.brief: Architecture photos and optional rooftop coffee.

d7-wenceslas.title: Wenceslas Square (optional)
d7-wenceslas.note: Only if not already visited and time permits; see the National Museum exterior or go straight to lunch.
d7-wenceslas.brief: New Town and National Museum exterior if time allows.

d7-miru.title: Náměstí Míru Peace Square Christmas market
d7-miru.note: Visit with friends after hotel check-in. Official hours 10 AM–8 PM, Nov 20–Dec 24. Skip Republic Square market.
d7-miru.brief: Christmas lights, local crafts and hot drinks in front of St Ludmila Church; closes at 8 PM.

d7-miru-transit.title: Travel to Peace Square Christmas market
d7-miru-transit.note: From Křižíkova take Metro B toward Zličín, change at Můstek to Metro A toward Depo Hostivař or Skalka and get off at Náměstí Míru.

d8-gate.title: Budějovická Gate and Latrán Street
d8-gate.note: Walk through the historic gate, past colorful Renaissance houses to the castle entrance. The surviving main town gate features Renaissance architecture. Latrán, the historic district beneath the castle, was once home to craftspeople and is lined with colorful houses. Photo tip: Photograph the arched gateway, colorful façades and the castle's Red Gate.
d8-gate.brief: Historic gate and colorful old houses.

d8-tower.title: Castle Museum and Tower (optional climb)
d8-tower.note: Winter hours 9:00 AM–3:30 PM. Explore historic noble collections. Climb only if visibility and stairs are safe. Indicative admission: 280 CZK per adult, 80 CZK per child aged 6–17; family total 720 CZK, subject to ticket desk confirmation. The iconic painted tower overlooks the town. The museum presents artifacts from the Rosenberg, Eggenberg and Schwarzenberg noble families. Photo tip: Photograph the painted façade and, if visibility and stairs are safe, the panorama from the tower.
d8-tower.brief: Museum first; climb only if safe and clear.

d8-coffee.title: Coffee, hot chocolate and dessert
d8-coffee.note: Choose a café near the square for a warm break; skip if short of time.
d8-coffee.brief: Indoor break before the last stops.

d8-church.title: St. Vitus Church
d8-church.note: Admire the Gothic church and prominent spire; enter only if open and time allows. A late Gothic church built primarily between 1407 and 1439, whose spire forms part of the iconic skyline. Photo tip: Photograph the spire and Gothic windows; enter only if open.
